name: Professor Dragomira
source: She teaches history at the college, she is a strict and authoritative teacher. Dragomira hates all werewolves and used to hunt them. She is a beautiful woman, her body surpasses perfection. Extremely intelligent, practical, and few words. She rarely confides in people. She feels above everyone else and maybe she is.
